_anonymised_copy: Anonymised copy of a registered protocol file: internal provenance fields (storage ids, hosts, resource accounting, internal review notes) were removed or redacted. Embedded sha256 values refer to the original registered file and do not match this copy.
nature: REGISTERED selection rule and single scoring pass for gated variants of the Parser arm P_k that re-use the CACHED Parser LLM generations (no new LLM inference, CPU only). Official MultiTQ test split REUSED (test.json sha256 d9bf3bf23b489ecc76c7940510c718260a42350d934a6edc1c1c7efcd5238fee). R3 analysis follows the R3 rule's registered plan (R3_secondary_analysis_for_method_tracks); R1/R2 are SECONDARY and descriptive; nothing is tuned on test, R1, R2 or R3.
question: Does executing the Parser hypothesis first, and adding the structural alternatives only when the hypothesis fails or is low-confidence, make the Parser arm lose less Hits@1 under LLM rewording (R3) than the frozen P_k, at k = 1/5/100%, and at what cost on original wording (full test, and k = 10% test-only)?

status_at_registration.new_outputs: None. No V2 or V3 prediction exists for any split; no PALONE/PK replay exists for dev_sel2000 or for the R3 / dev-paraphrase rewrite rows; this track has computed no Hits for any question.
work_before_registration: Read the R3 rule + A1-A3, the structural-ablation code (sa_parser_replay.py, sa_score_A.py), r3_common.py / r2_common.py, r3_dev_score.py, jobA3.sh / jobBC3.sh, kpct_executor.compact_to_parse, and the kpct rule's tau definition (mean token log-prob of the JSON).

Listed files on the GPU host (WORK_DIR: parser/raw, parser/exec, bundles, preds, robustness_r3/llm) and checked by sha256 that the dev_sel2000 S_k fallback lists and the rewrite-root S_k lists equal the fallback_source recorded in the frozen exec_stats files (seed0 checked at every k).

Read the field names of the cached raw Parser files (quid, text, n_out, mean_logprob, min_logprob, finish_reason) on 2 dev_sel2000 rows and 2 test rows (generated text only, no gold), and counted the rewrite-root raw rows by variant index (R3 vidx 4: 578, DEV_ACCEPTED vidx 5: 1,762, DEVPARA_JREJ vidx 6: 192 at each of k01_s0 / k05_s0 / k100). Listed the member names of the R1 / R2 / R3 / structural-ablation archives.
status_at_registration.known_numbers: Known to the designers: the frozen P_k / S_k full-test Hits@1 (kpct), and the structural-ablation results on test, R1 and R2 for PK (= frozen P_k) vs PALONE (= V1 below), i.e. V1's original-test and R1/R2 numbers already exist (registered elsewhere; they are reported again here as reuse, not re-decided). The R3 track's dev table for the frozen arms (V0 dev numbers) exists as a file; this track has not opened it. No R3 Hits exist for any arm (R3 freeze [id]; first scored in the method tracks' passes). V2 and V3 have no numbers on any split.

variants.common: All variants use the cached greedy Parser generation of the frozen adapter (k01_s0 ep3, k05_s0 ep1, k10_s0 ep0.5, k100 ep0.5), the frozen executor (probs='classifier', top 50) and the 3 S_k LightGBM seeds; per-question hits = mean over the 3 seeds. Execution modes as in sa_parser_replay.py (unchanged, sha256 e54870232cb85099587ed5a4038a89bad896e2e6a77e77d6a8af97351ffdd4fd): PK = hypothesis + deduplicated structural alternatives (= frozen P_k), PALONE = hypothesis only. Each mode falls back to S_k's own list (same seed) on invalid JSON / unknown name (mode-independent) and on execution error / invalid execution / empty pool (mode-specific): files pred_<mode>_<k>_<split>_fb_seed<b>.jsonl. Every variant therefore routes each question to either the PALONE_fb list or the PK_fb list.
variants.V0: frozen P_k (registered baseline): the frozen pred_P_<k>_<split>_..._tauoff_seed<b> files (= PK_fb; replay identity checked).
variants.V1: PALONE: route = PALONE_fb for every question (hypothesis only, registered S_k fallback).
variants.V2: alternatives only as fallback: route = PALONE_fb if the PALONE execution is ok (valid, non-empty pool); otherwise PK_fb (hypothesis + alternatives; if that also fails, S_k). When the cached JSON is invalid or names an unknown entity/relation there is no executable hypothesis and every variant uses S_k (the structural parse alone).
variants.V3(t): confidence-gated alternatives: route = PK_fb if the Parser's mean token log-prob of the generated JSON (raw field mean_logprob, the kpct tau signal) < t; otherwise the V2 route. A missing mean_logprob counts as below every t. Threshold grid t in {-0.30, -0.10, -0.03, -0.01, -0.003} (kpct tau grid plus two finer steps), chosen on dev per level.
variants.confidence_signal_available: YES: mean_logprob and min_logprob are cached in every raw Parser file (test, dev_sel2000, R1, R2, R3/dev rewrite roots). Only mean_logprob is used (registered); min_logprob is not used.

selection_rule.data: dev only: dev_sel2000 ORIG (2,000 questions; Parser raw = parser/raw/<k>/raw_P_dev_sel2000_<ckpt>.jsonl.gz) and the DEV_ACCEPTED paraphrases (1,762; vidx 5 of the R3-track rewrite root robustness_r3/llm). Gold = official dev.json answers; official multitq_eval.hit_at_k.
selection_rule.constraint: feasible iff Hits@1(dev ORIG 2,000; seed mean) >= Hits@1(V0, dev ORIG) - 0.003 (a loss of at most 0.3 points vs V0 at the same level). V0 is always feasible.
selection_rule.objective: among feasible candidates maximise Hits@1(DEV_ACCEPTED paraphrases, 1,762; seed mean)
selection_rule.ties: candidates within 0.0005 of the feasible maximum are tied; choose the first in the order V0 < V1 < V2 < V3(-0.30) < V3(-0.10) < V3(-0.03) < V3(-0.01) < V3(-0.003) (status quo first, then fewer components / fewer appended questions)
selection_rule.k10_transfer: No Parser generation exists for any rewrite at k10 (P_10 was not run on rewrites; no new inference). k10 variant = the variant family chosen by majority over k = 1/5/100 (V3 thresholds count as one family; if all three differ, the first of the three in the tie order); a V3 family choice uses the median of the selected thresholds (the lower when two). The k10 choice must satisfy the same dev ORIG constraint at k10 (dev_sel2000, k10 raw ep0.5); if it fails, k10 = V0. k10 results are original-test only.
selection_rule.record: the full dev table (every candidate x level: dev ORIG Hits@1, DEV_ACCEPTED ORIG / PARA Hits@1, drop, Hits@10, routing shares) and the selected variant per level are written to multitq_parser_first_selection.json and saved as a file BEFORE the freeze and before any test / R1 / R2 / R3 score.
selection_rule.descriptive_dev: DEV_MECH_OK (vidx 5 union 6) Hits@1 of every candidate is reported (descriptive, not used for selection).

pipeline.replay: the GPU host CPU-only container (tkgqa-gpu:latest, no --gpus, kpct tree mounted read-only): sa_parser_replay.py (unchanged) for split dev_sel2000 at k01_s0 / k05_s0 / k10_s0 / k100 and for the rewrite root robustness_r3/llm (split variants: R3 vidx 4 + DEV_ACCEPTED vidx 5 + DEVPARA_JREJ vidx 6) at k01_s0 / k05_s0 / k100; fallback lists = the S_k files whose sha256 the frozen exec_stats record.
pipeline.reuse: test (54,584; k01_s0 / k05_s0 / k10_s0 / k100), R1 and R2 (k01_s0 / k05_s0 / k100): the frozen PK_fb / PALONE_fb files and per-question mode status of the structural-ablation predictions_A (frozen by freeze_A [id] before its scoring); the raw mean_logprob from the frozen raw files (test: parser/raw; R1 / R2 / R3 roots: the frozen archives).
pipeline.routing: a gold-free routing table (per split, level, question: PALONE status, PK status, mean_logprob, route of every candidate) built from the files above; prediction files of the SELECTED variant at each level are materialised by copying the routed lists (top 50, 3 seeds) for test, R3 rewrites, R1 and R2.
pipeline.R3_ORIG_reference: as the R3 rule: ORIG predictions = each arm's predictions on the original FULL-test question (V0: frozen P_k test files; V1-V3: their routed test lists), so method and baseline drops share the same original-question reference.
pipeline.R1_R2_ORIG_reference: as the structural-ablation scoring of R1/R2: the ORIG rows (vidx 0) of the R1 / R2 rewrite roots.

identity_checks.I_P1: replayed PK_fb vs the frozen P_k files on dev_sel2000 (4 levels) and on the rewrite root (3 levels): top-1 identity >= 99.5% for every seed and level (full-list identity reported); else STOP_PIPELINE_DRIFT (one logged bug-fix allowed).
identity_checks.I_P2: V0 lists used for R3 / test = the frozen P_k files verified by sha256 against the R3 freeze / kpct hash records.

freeze: After selection: sha256 of every source prediction / pool / raw file used, of the routing table, of the materialised selected-variant files and of the selection JSON, written to multitq_parser_first_freeze.json and saved as a file BEFORE the single scoring pass.

scoring_pass.once: one registered pass (score_pf.py) after the freeze record exists; no rescoring with changed inputs; results never changed after they are computed.
scoring_pass.test: for each level k in {1, 5, 10, 100}: Hits@1 (and Hits@10) on the full official test split (54,584) of the selected variant m_k and of V0_k, seed mean; 95% percentile CI by Poisson(1) bootstrap (r2_common.summarise, B = 10,000, seed 20261118); paired contrast m_k - V0_k with two-sided 95% CI (same bootstrap). Original-wording cost label (descriptive guard): ORIG_COST iff the CI lies entirely below 0; ORIG_WITHIN_0.3 iff the CI lower bound >= -0.003; else ORIG_INCONCLUSIVE. If m_k = V0 the contrast is identically 0 and labelled METHOD_EQUALS_BASELINE.
scoring_pass.R3: R3 PRIMARY (578 rewrites) and their original questions, k in {1, 5, 100}: Hits@1 on R3 ORIG, R3 rewrites, drop; contrasts c_drop = drop(V0) - drop(m), c_rw = RW(m) - RW(V0) (r3_common.contrasts / method_tests): paired Poisson(1) bootstrap B = 10,000, seed 20261118, one-sided p = share of bootstrap means <= 0, two-sided 95% CI and one-sided 95% lower bound; Holm within this method over all its R3 tests = {levels with m_k != V0} x {c_drop, c_rw}; SUPPORTED iff Holm-adjusted p < 0.05. Levels where m_k = V0 are reported as METHOD_EQUALS_BASELINE and are not tests. R3 results are SECONDARY robustness evidence.
scoring_pass.R1_R2: SECONDARY, descriptive: the same contrasts on R1 (per variant P1_prefix, P2_qmark, P3_paraphrase; root rows) and R2 (RW rewrites, root rows) at k in {1, 5, 100}, same bootstrap; Holm reported separately per probe, descriptive labels only.
scoring_pass.all_candidates_descriptive: Hits@1 of every candidate (V0, V1, V2, V3 at each t) on full test, R3 ORIG / RW / drop, R1, R2: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY (trade-off curve), not tests, never used to change the selection, and not part of the R3 audit's targeted set.
scoring_pass.audit_feed: per-question c_drop and c_rw of the selected variant vs V0 at each level on the R3 PRIMARY quids (for r3_common.audit_selection after every method track is frozen).

stop_rules.STOP_PIPELINE_DRIFT: I_P1 failure after one logged bug-fix
stop_rules.STOP_TEST_INTEGRITY: any sha256 mismatch of a frozen source file
stop_rules.NO_INFERENCE: a variant that would need new Parser generations is NOT_RUN

selection_discipline: Variant, threshold and k10 transfer chosen on dev only by the rule above; no change after any test / R1 / R2 / R3 number is read; anything not listed here is POST_HOC and not decision-relevant.
